title: NY RE Exam — Wayfinding Home (iPad landscape)
prompt:
iPad landscape home screen (iPad Pro 11, 1194 x 834 pt, dark mode) for "NY RE Exam", a personal cram app for the New York State real estate salesperson exam. This is the tablet re-flow of the existing phone home screen in the same "Wayfinding" design system: New York subway signage language. Every syllabus topic is a colored circular route bullet with one bold character; progress is drawn as a line with station dots. Everything else is quiet, native-iPadOS polish on a dark OLED canvas. It must feel like a native iPad app, not a stretched phone column: use the width for a dashboard grid and fit everything above the floating tab bar without scrolling.

Typography: Helvetica Neue bold for headings and all numbers (tabular figures, tight -0.02em tracking), system UI for body text (17px). Sentence case everywhere. No all-caps labels, no middle-dot separators, no arrows on buttons.

Layout: 40px side gutters, content max width 1120px, 20px gaps, a 12-column bento grid.
1. Compact large-title header row: small square app mark, then "NY RE Exam" in 34px bold.
2. Top row of the bento, equal height cards:
   a) Left, spanning 7 columns: the hero, the one bold moment. The exam countdown as an NYC subway platform arrival board: a 24-radius card (#111725) holding a near-black inset board (#05080f). Board header row: destination "NYS salesperson exam" and, right-aligned, "Oct 14 & 15". Below, three big split-flap tiles side by side, 64px Helvetica Neue bold tabular numerals, each tile with a thin horizontal split line through its middle: "6" days, "07" hours, "05" minutes, small lowercase unit words under each tile. Under the board one quiet centered line: "Pass with 53 of 75 correct in 90 minutes."
   b) Right, spanning 5 columns: readiness card (18 radius, #111725). A 140px circular ring gauge on the left showing 64% with a short white tick on the ring marking the 70% pass line; ring is amber (#f59e0b) below 70%. Big "64%" in the centre with "readiness" under it. To its right three stat rows separated by a hairline (label left in #a3b1c6, value right in white bold): Study streak "4 days", Questions seen "212 / 430", Accuracy "71%".
3. Second row of the bento:
   a) Left, spanning 7 columns: a slim resume card: title "Quick 10-Question Drill", secondary text "Question 2 of 10, study mode", a "Resume" green-tinted pill button on the right, and under it a full-width 4px line with 10 station dots (1 filled green, the current one ringed green).
      Under it, a row of three equal practice tiles, each 14 radius, left-aligned icon on top then title and one secondary line: the first is the solid green (#10b981) primary tile with dark text "Quick 10-Question Drill" / "Ten mixed questions with instant feedback"; then "Mock 75-Question NYS State Exam" / "75 questions in 90 minutes, timed" with a clock icon in #182033; then "Custom Quiz Builder" / "Pick topics, length and mode" with a sliders icon in #182033.
   b) Right, spanning 5 columns, full height of the row: "Weakest lines" card. Heading "Weakest lines" (22px bold) with "5 under 70%" meta right-aligned. A list of 3 rows divided by 1px hairlines; each row: a 28px colored route bullet with one bold character (orange #FF6319 dark text "R" Commercial, green #00843D "6" Math, green #00843D "4" Finance), the topic name, a thin accuracy bar under the name with a small tick at the 70% pass line, and the accuracy right-aligned in red (#ef4444): 48%, 53%, 58%. At the bottom of the card a full-width tonal button "Retest Weak Areas" (dark raised #182033 fill, white text, not green).
4. Floating glass capsule tab bar centered at the bottom, 600px wide, 16px above the bottom edge, fully rounded, translucent dark with backdrop blur and one soft shadow; 5 tabs with the icon left of the label in a row: Home (active, green pill, green label), Build, Stats, Mistakes, More.

Palette: canvas #090d16, surface #111725, raised #182033, hairline rgba(148,163,184,.16), ink #f1f5f9, secondary ink #a3b1c6, go #10b981, stop #ef4444, caution #f59e0b. Elevation by surface lightness, not shadows. Radius: 24 hero, 18 cards, 14 controls, full pills for bullets. Feel: calm, precise, native iPadOS, transit-signage clarity. Spend the boldness only on the arrival-board countdown.
